summary: Iteration 23 — 'Finance this job' button on Job Detail. Backend POST /api/financing/from-job tested (9/9 pytest pass) including idempotency, min-$500 validation, 404 for bogus job, technician role access, job back-reference, and graceful SMS error structures. Frontend UI verified: button visible only for jobs with price>=500, modal opens with prefilled amount/term=36, 'Create link only' produces green success card with public URL + 'Open customer view' link, success toast appears, button correctly hidden on low-price jobs.
critical_code_review_comments: financing.py POST /financing/from-job is well-structured, idempotent via {company_id, job_id} index lookup, multi-tenant safe (uses user.company_id), graceful SMS fallbacks return structured errors rather than 500.
Consider adding a database index on finance_applications.{company_id, job_id} for idempotency lookup performance as volume grows (currently linear scan).
Pydantic JobFinanceIn enforces term_months 6..84 — matches existing ApplicationCreateIn. Good.

Minor: when calling from-job a second time with a different amount/term, the existing application is reused as-is (correct for idempotency) — UI should make this clear to the tech (current modal would just show the original term). Not a blocker.

JobDetail.jsx FinanceJobModal correctly uses data-testid attributes (finance-job-modal, finance-job-amount, finance-job-term, finance-job-create, finance-job-create-sms, finance-job-copy, finance-job-result, detail-finance-button). Toast messaging matches the four sms_result.error cases.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_iter23_* jobs via POST /api/jobs during pytest runs (each with TEST_ prefix). Also one TEST_UI_finance job from the UI run. Not auto-cleaned — consider periodic cleanup of TEST_* jobs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 backend tests in test_iteration_23_finance_from_job.py pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. UI verified for owner role on web (Chromium). Mobile (Expo) flow not testable here. Twilio is intentionally not configured — sms_result.error='twilio_not_configured' is the expected happy path for the SMS branch. POST /api/jobs requires status enum (use 'in_progress' or 'scheduled_installation', NOT 'scheduled').
